title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) TypeScript SDK v1.2
what_happened: Official v1.2 release providing native streaming tool responses and multi-agent resource discovery protocols.
why_trending: Developers are standardizing on MCP as the unified interface connecting AI models with local developer tools and APIs.
why_care: Allows building interoperable agent plugins without vendor lock-in to OpenAI or Anthropic proprietary formats.
what_to_build: Turn any existing database or REST API into an instant MCP tool server.

title: Telegram Bot API 7.9: Stars Subscriptions & Digital Invoicing
what_happened: Telegram expanded Stars to support recurring monthly subscriptions and instant refunds for digital products directly inside Mini Apps.
why_trending: Unlocks true SaaS business models for Telegram bot builders without traditional Stripe payment friction.
why_care: Direct access to monetize 950M+ Telegram users with single-click payment confirmation.
what_to_build: Micro-SaaS or course community bot charging monthly subscription fees in Telegram Stars.
